description: This file contains the PHP class 'ReturnReason' which manages return reasons in the Opencart e-commerce platform. It includes methods for adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving return reasons and their descriptions, facilitating CRUD operations along with caching mechanisms.

classes.name: ReturnReason
classes.description: Represents the ReturnReason model responsible for handling CRUD operations on return reasons within the Opencart admin panel.

methods.name: addReturnReason
methods.description: Adds a new return reason to the database, inserts descriptions for each language, and clears the relevant cache.

methods.name: editReturnReason
methods.description: Updates an existing return reason and its descriptions, then clears the cache.

methods.name: deleteReturnReason
methods.description: Deletes a specific return reason from the database and clears the cache.

methods.name: deleteReturnReasonsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all return reasons associated with a specific language ID from the database.

methods.name: getReturnReason
methods.description: Retrieves a return reason by its ID, including its data for the current language.

methods.name: getReturnReasons
methods.description: Fetches all return reasons, optionally with pagination and sorting, for the current language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Gets all descriptions for a specific return reason ID across all languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all return reason descriptions filtered by a specific language ID.

methods.name: getTotalReturnReasons
methods.description: Returns the total number of return reasons available for the current language.
